explanation: Football-level defensive mechanics and contingent route stresses; no individual defensive play-art verification implied.

match_checks.bingo: Box-style check with outside corner locking #1 under an outside-release condition.
match_checks.box: Bunch routes exchanged according to directional areas (deep outside/inside and short outside/inside).
match_checks.combo: Man defenders trade stack releases by inside/outside destination.
match_checks.point_combo: Bunch point stays locked; others trade releases.
match_checks.point_triangle: Bunch point receiver assigned plus layered help around the other releases.
match_checks.skate: Underneath players widen against bunch/trips quick passing.
match_checks.skinny: Carry vertical and outside releases using selected check rules.
match_checks.skinny_meg: Backside corner may lock the isolated receiver.
match_checks.solo: Isolated corner locks lone WR while safety can help elsewhere.
match_checks.solo_cut: Safety can take shallow inside break by lone WR while corner poaches help.
match_checks.stress: Keep sound deep spacing versus multiple vertical threats.
match_checks.stubbie: Trips: outside corner locks #1; nickel, safety and under defender relate to #2/#3.
match_checks.stump: Trips check with increased help against #1 releasing short.
match_checks.top_hat: Stack defenders exchange who takes front/back receiver.
match_checks.triangle: Defenders form 3-over-2 or 4-over-3 layered coverage, helper deep.
match_checks.zone_it: Selected match coverage switches to straight zone for the check.

not_model_policy: Never force a play or read from this table; present as features and conditional explanations scored by the learned coordinator.

cover_0.conditional_read: If pressure comes and the nearest man defender is isolated, quick separation becomes valuable.
cover_0.counter_guardrail: A covered quick throw or a free rusher can still defeat the play; do not assume every blitz is Cover 0.
cover_0.mechanics: Eligible defenders are locked in man with extra rush threats and little deep safety help; specific rushers and assignments require play art.
cover_0.potential_offensive_stress: Quick in/out routes, legal picks and hot answers may separate before the rush.

cover_1_contain.conditional_read: QB scramble lane may be protected even when coverage is man.
cover_1_contain.counter_guardrail: Don't recommend quarterback scramble without evaluating contain.
cover_1_contain.mechanics: One-high man with contain/spy emphasis against mobile quarterback.
cover_1_contain.potential_offensive_stress: Read defender leverage on crossing routes and attack space by timing.

cover_1_hole.conditional_read: A drag crossing the low hook can be carried or cut by the hole defender.
cover_1_hole.counter_guardrail: The hole defender can wall inside breaks; QB must confirm leverage.
cover_1_hole.mechanics: Man coverage with deep middle safety and low-middle hole defender, commonly linebacker.
cover_1_hole.potential_offensive_stress: Man-beating releases and routes outside the hook may generate windows.

cover_1_robber.conditional_read: An inside dig/crosser may attract the robber while a different release changes his angle.
cover_1_robber.counter_guardrail: Do not prescribe deep posts as automatically open: deep safety remains in middle.
cover_1_robber.mechanics: Man coverage with low-middle robber, often safety, actively driving inside routes.
cover_1_robber.potential_offensive_stress: Outside releases or routes that stretch the robber's leverage may open a window.

cover_1_unspecified.conditional_read: Identify the deep middle safety; do not pretend to know whether a hole or robber player is present.
cover_1_unspecified.counter_guardrail: A low helper may cut crossing routes and the user defender may cheat windows.
cover_1_unspecified.mechanics: Single-high man family but the free/low helper is not resolved from this generic name.
cover_1_unspecified.potential_offensive_stress: Crossing routes, drags, leverage-beating breaks and route stacks may challenge man.

cover_2_invert.conditional_read: Read the rotation rather than expecting original high safeties to remain deep.
cover_2_invert.counter_guardrail: Initial two-high picture may disguise different actual post-snap assignments.
cover_2_invert.mechanics: Inverted two-deep: corners can fall into deep halves while safeties rotate underneath.
cover_2_invert.potential_offensive_stress: Route timing and intermediate holes may differ from ordinary Cover 2.

cover_2_man.conditional_read: Look for defender turning in man; do not treat underneath flat defenders as static zones.
cover_2_man.counter_guardrail: Deep post may be bracketed by two-high support; confirm safeties.
cover_2_man.mechanics: Two safeties help deep over defenders assigned to man underneath.
cover_2_man.potential_offensive_stress: Legal separation routes, rub/stacks and outlet mismatch can challenge man.

cover_2_spot.conditional_read: If safeties split, deep middle seam can become a window, depending on hook runner and safety midpoint.
cover_2_spot.counter_guardrail: The MLB and safeties can carry the post; a deep post is NOT always primary.
cover_2_spot.mechanics: Outside corners play flats and safeties defend deep halves; underneath defenders relate to hook/curl landmarks.
cover_2_spot.potential_offensive_stress: Seam, high/low, smash and intermediate sideline stress may create defensive conflicts.

cover_2_unspecified.conditional_read: Check beneath the safeties for man turn or zone eyes before selecting a throwing window.
cover_2_unspecified.counter_guardrail: Do not silently map generic Cover 2 to spot-drop zone or Tampa 2.
cover_2_unspecified.mechanics: Generic two-deep label; underlying man versus zone is not independently established.
cover_2_unspecified.potential_offensive_stress: Depth, seam and boundary concepts are candidates for evaluation, not a fixed counter.

cover_3_match.conditional_read: If #2 pushes vertical a match defender may carry him rather than stay at his landmark; formation check matters.
cover_3_match.counter_guardrail: No static 'Cover 3 hole' guaranteed; bunch/trips checks change defender jobs.
cover_3_match.mechanics: Three-deep match coverage with receivers' releases changing underneath carrying responsibilities.
cover_3_match.potential_offensive_stress: Combinations that force release exchanges can stress a match rule when properly timed.

cover_3_sky.conditional_read: Check which safety/corner rotates to the flat/hook and who owns vertical release.
cover_3_sky.counter_guardrail: Do not automatically equate Sky with all spot-drop rules.
cover_3_sky.mechanics: Three-deep structure with a sky rotation; match check or specific underneath exchanges are not established by label alone.
cover_3_sky.potential_offensive_stress: Flood/spacing can stress deep and underneath levels if the defense lacks matching adjustment.

cover_3_unspecified.conditional_read: Check whether underneath defenders carry vertical releases versus dropping to space.
cover_3_unspecified.counter_guardrail: Do not assume flood is an unconditional Cover 3 beater.
cover_3_unspecified.mechanics: Three deep label without evidence separating match and spot-drop rules.
cover_3_unspecified.potential_offensive_stress: Seams and layered outside throws can create conflicts if a defender is threatened.

cover_4_drop.conditional_read: Observe whether quarters defenders stay spatially deep as crossers leave their landmarks.
cover_4_drop.counter_guardrail: Timing and underneath help still matter; don't assume empty zones.
cover_4_drop.mechanics: Four deep spatial quarters; underneath players hold zone areas, not automatic receiver matching.
cover_4_drop.potential_offensive_stress: Underneath spacing and intermediate floods may create zone conflict.

cover_4_palms.conditional_read: Identify a quick out by #2 before assuming corner carries the outside #1 receiver.
cover_4_palms.counter_guardrail: Quarters and Palms share two-high shell; releases and chosen checks distinguish them.
cover_4_palms.mechanics: Two-read coverage; when #2 releases quickly outside, corner can take him while safety may carry #1.
cover_4_palms.potential_offensive_stress: Counter should account for the corner-safety exchange, seam and window timing.

cover_4_quarters.conditional_read: If #2 is vertical, safety carries; if #2 releases under, the safety may find inside help.
cover_4_quarters.counter_guardrail: Trips checks can replace standard quarters; don't automatically attack post.
cover_4_quarters.mechanics: Quarters matches vertical receivers; the safety's #2 responsibility depends on release and check.
cover_4_quarters.potential_offensive_stress: Run and underneath layers or opposite-side crossers can influence defender distribution.

cover_4_unspecified.conditional_read: Study defender's response to #2 release before deciding on short out or inside break.
cover_4_unspecified.counter_guardrail: Do not assume Palms or Quarters from four-deep shell.
cover_4_unspecified.mechanics: Four-deep generic label without confirmed match, Palms or drop mechanics.
cover_4_unspecified.potential_offensive_stress: Underneath and paired high-low routes may stress uncovered space if defenders retreat.

cover_6.conditional_read: Identify which side is half and which is quarters, and how formation-check treats trips.
cover_6.counter_guardrail: Do not hardcode quarter side from call; rotations/alignments matter.
cover_6.mechanics: Split-field mixture of quarters/match principles on one side and Cover-2 half on other.
cover_6.potential_offensive_stress: Choose target based on observed side-specific spacing rather than coverage name alone.

cover_9.conditional_read: Verify which side plays deep half versus quarters post-snap.
cover_9.counter_guardrail: Cover 9 is not same as Cover 6 when offense changes formation strength.
cover_9.mechanics: Opposite orientation relative to standard Cover 6, splitting deep halves and quarters by side.
cover_9.potential_offensive_stress: Exploit side-specific release rules after confirming orientation.

tampa_2.conditional_read: Observe whether middle runner gains depth to cap post/seam, then look to a different layer.
tampa_2.counter_guardrail: Do not call it identical to spot Cover 2; middle runner changes throwing window.
tampa_2.mechanics: Cover 2 shell plus middle runner carrying vertical seam, reducing the vulnerable deep-middle window.
tampa_2.potential_offensive_stress: Underneath spacing and outside intermediate sideline combinations can stress other areas.

trap_2.conditional_read: Observe whether underneath defender is squatting on quick out/flat.
trap_2.counter_guardrail: A 'free' flat can be a trap; check actual Madden settings.
trap_2.mechanics: Trap coverage can encourage a corner/underneath defender to jump short outside route with deep help behind.
trap_2.potential_offensive_stress: Read corner behavior before committing to a quick throw.

screen_label_policy: Historical coverage_seen values are NOT screen-verified post-play results without evidence locator.
